designationHistory.name: Las Vegas-Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: The refuge was established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as part of the combined Las Vegas-Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge in northeastern New Mexico.
designationHistory.note: FWS CCP: established August 24, 1965; Director John S. Gottschalk approved splitting Las Vegas-Maxwell into two refuges on July 27, 1966.
